title: rangetest: cur_skip_item argument*2 wraps for map arguments >= 2^63
description: coap_rangetest.c:251: argument * 2U wraps for arguments >= 2^63 making the container appear empty so subsequent bytes realign the parse relative to stricter decoders - interop divergence on untrusted unknown-key values (no memory unsafety; termination and bounds hold). Fix: reject argument > UINT64_MAX/2 or bound by remaining input length.
close_reason: cur_skip_item now rejects map arguments > UINT64_MAX/2 before the *2 doubling (would wrap to 0, making the container look empty and realigning the parse on untrusted unknown-key values). Regression test test_skip_item_rejects_wrapping_map_argument: a body whose unknown-key value is map(2^63) followed by a valid interval_ms key must be rejected atomically (pre-fix it was accepted with the trailing key honored). Twister 8/8. Commit 4c33ee2345.
